entries.text: New models: Ling-3.2-air (InclusionAI, open weights under MIT, 124B total / 5.5B active parameters) and Kolibri 1.1 (Aleph Alpha, German-English, open weights under Apache-2.0, 75.1B total / 3.44B active), both released on 2026-11-23. Artificial Analysis gives Ling-3.2-air 23 on its Intelligence Index; Kolibri 1.1 so far has only results reported by Aleph Alpha.
ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview (Baidu) now has open weights: Baidu published them on Hugging Face on 2026-11-23 under Apache-2.0, which covers the Preview weights only.

Artificial Analysis moved its Intelligence Index to v5.0.2: Terminal-Bench 4.1 replaces 4.0 and FrontierCode 2.0 was regraded. Gemini 4 Neon (xhigh) rises from 61 to 62, Gemini 4 Argon (high) from 50 to 51 and Kimi K3.1 Pro from 46 to 47.

New board: Vals AI's Vibe Code Bench v1.1.1, which replaces v1.1 with stricter grading (every substep of a test must pass). Claude Fable 5.2 leads at 83.52%, ahead of Claude Sonnet 5.5 (80.88%) and Gemini 4 Neon (80.23%). Vals also re-scored its Vals Index: all values are lower, and Claude Fable 5.2 stays first at 70.06.
Kaggle Game Arena adds Gemini 4 Neon, Gemini 4 Hydrogen, GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol. On the chess board Gemini 4 Neon leads with 1791, ahead of Gemini 4 Carbon (1651) and GPT-6.2 Astra (1585).

Reputation: Gemini 4 Neon now has 26 first-hand opinions, 83% positive; Inkling 2 Mini gets its first entry (25 opinions, 56% positive; users praise its coding results for its size and report overthinking and slow local generation). On OpenRouter, Hy4 flash moves to #2 for the week with 23.5T tokens.

New model: GLM-5.4 (Z.ai), released to GLM Coding Plan subscribers on 2026-11-23 with vision input and, according to Z.ai, stronger coding performance. There is no public API, open weights or benchmark result yet, so it has no scores.

New board: Surge AI's DAYJOB: Law (71 legal assignments, 25 tracked models). GPT-6.2 Astra leads at 41.4% of attempts passed, ahead of GPT-6 Astra (36.6%) and GPT-6.2 Sol (32.7%); Claude Fable 5.2 has 26.5%.
Epoch AI re-fit its Capabilities Index and added Gemini 4 Hydrogen (166.81). Claude Fable 5.2 (173.4) now leads GPT-6.2 Astra (172.82, down from 174.17).
Arena Text, WebDev and Creative Writing moved to the 2026-11-22 snapshot. Design Arena Game Dev: Claude Fable 5.2 rose from 1392 to 1536 and Gemini 4 Carbon from 1325 to 1410.
Terminal-Bench 4.1 adds Hy4 flash at 11.8% (mini-swe-agent); Scale's Remote Labor Index adds Gemini 4 Carbon at 20.0%; Artificial Analysis lists Gemini 4 Argon's cost per task at $9.95 (was $4.97).
OpenRouter weekly ranking (data through 2026-11-21): DeepSeek V4.1 Flash stays first; Hy4 flash is now sixth with 6.51T tokens (46.6T in the previous snapshot); Kimi K3.1 Pro re-enters the top 10.

New model: Qwen4-Max (Alibaba, released 11-16; closed weights, $1.50 / $4.50 per 1M tokens; the launch post states a 2.4T-parameter backbone with 71B active). First results: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 43, Vals Index 63.20, Vals Vibe Code Bench 86.66, Terminal-Bench 4.0 48.48 (Vals), NYT Connections 90.8 (Lech Mazur) and Arena WebDev 1749.8. It succeeds Qwen3.8 Max in Alibaba's flagship line, so Qwen3.7 Max leaves the tracked set

Parallel's search leaderboard: GPT-6.1 Terra 69.7 → 69.2 after a re-evaluation on 11-14

Scale Labs: SWE Atlas v1.1 adds Beam 1.0 (34.72) and now prints two decimals, so 99 stored best scores were refined by at most 0.05; Humanity's Last Exam (Diamond) adds Muse Ember (22.0). Status: Inception's documentation now says the Mercury API is winding down and stays available through 2026-12-28; Parallel's search leaderboard no longer lists Mercury 3 (the stored 63.6 of 11-13 is kept with its date). Hy4's weights are still not public. Correction: the description of the archived Vals Vibe Code Bench 1-100 v1 was rewritten from Vals' page
